How this is calculated
  • Each round one of 25 tiles wins at random. 10 tiles per round are solo tiles, fixed before anyone deploys; the rest are split tiles.
  • Split round: 1 ORE is shared by everyone on the winning tile, by SOL share. Solo round: one miner on the winning tile takes the 1 ORE, picked at random weighted by SOL.
  • SOL: ORE gives every miner their own SOL back each round, minus a 1% admin fee on every tile and 10% of the rest on tiles that lose. On average that costs about 10.5% of what you deploy, whatever the pot size. SOL does not move between players, so your SOL balance drains smoothly.
  • ORE's Explore "production cost" counts only the 10% fee, divided by the 1.2 ORE minted each round (1 ORE plus 0.2 into the Motherlode), averaged over 20 rounds. The calculator adds about 10% for the 1% admin fee, and another 10% when you claim.
  • Motherlode: 1 in 500 rounds; the whole pool goes to the winning tile by SOL share. Expected value uses the typical pool inside your Motherlode range.
  • Assumes every tile holds about the same SOL. Real rounds vary, so read results as averages.
  • Run results use how pots moved with the Motherlode over 35,655 rounds (Sep–Oct 2026): pots ran about 8% below average with the Motherlode under 50 and up to 50% above it past 300. Your current pot size is scaled to each Motherlode range from that.

Estimates, not promises: results are averages and luck decides any single run. Mining uses up real SOL and ORE's price can move. Not financial advice.
